title: Axolotl dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="65" rx="22" ry="18" fill="#f7a8c4"/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="14" ry="12" fill="#ffd0e0"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M68 72 Q82 78 88 68 Q84 82 68 82 Q76 76 68 72Z" fill="#f28fb3"/>
  <!-- left leg dancing up -->
  <path d="M32 78 Q22 88 26 92 Q34 92 36 82Z" fill="#f28fb3"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="92" r="3" fill="#ffd0e0"/>
  <!-- right leg down -->
  <path d="M62 80 Q68 90 72 92 Q76 88 68 78Z" fill="#f28fb3"/>
  <circle cx="73" cy="92" r="3" fill="#ffd0e0"/>
  <!-- left arm up -->
  <path d="M32 58 Q18 48 20 38 Q28 44 34 54Z" fill="#f7a8c4"/>
  <!-- right arm out -->
  <path d="M68 58 Q82 52 86 44 Q80 44 72 54Z" fill="#f7a8c4"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="20" ry="17" fill="#f7a8c4"/>
  <!-- gills left -->
  <path d="M32 38 Q20 28 24 22 Q30 28 34 34Z" fill="#ff8fb0"/>
  <path d="M32 44 Q18 42 18 36 Q28 38 33 42Z" fill="#ff8fb0"/>
  <path d="M33 50 Q22 54 20 48 Q28 48 34 48Z" fill="#ff8fb0"/>
  <!-- gills right -->
  <path d="M68 38 Q80 28 76 22 Q70 28 66 34Z" fill="#ff8fb0"/>
  <path d="M68 44 Q82 42 82 36 Q72 38 67 42Z" fill="#ff8fb0"/>
  <path d="M67 50 Q78 54 80 48 Q72 48 66 48Z" fill="#ff8fb0"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="43" cy="41" rx="3" ry="4" fill="#4a2c5a"/>
  <ellipse cx="57" cy="41" rx="3" ry="4" fill="#4a2c5a"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="40" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="40" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M44 49 Q50 54 56 49" stroke="#4a2c5a" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="48" r="3" fill="#ff7fa8" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="48" r="3" fill="#ff7fa8" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- dance motion lines -->
  <path d="M24 30 Q20 26 22 22" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M78 28 Q82 24 80 20" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 20 Q52 14 48 12" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <g fill="#66d9ff">
    <circle cx="16" cy="60" r="3"/>
    <rect x="18" y="48" width="2" height="12"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#66d9ff">
    <circle cx="86" cy="62" r="2.5"/>
    <rect x="88" y="52" width="2" height="10"/>
  </g>
</svg>
